<document id="RB-BPS46-TANYARD-ATS Rev C" title="Runbook: BPS-46 Tanyard Branch Booster Automatic Transfer Switch" family="runbook">
<passage n="00" section="Control box">
SGW  WATER DISTRIBUTION

RB-BPS46-TANYARD-ATS Rev C
RUNBOOK: BPS-46 TANYARD BRANCH BOOSTER AUTOMATIC TRANSFER SWITCH

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Document: RB-BPS46-TANYARD-ATS Rev C                                                         |
| Effective: 2023-06-19                                                                        |
| Owner: Water Distribution                                                                    |
| Subject Matter Expert: Lumpkin, Harlan E.                                                    |
| Periodic review due: 2025-05-31                                                              |
| Classification: SGW Internal - Controlled                                                    |
| Approved: Manager, Water Distribution, Sistrunk, Odell M., 2023-06-19                        |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="01" section="Revision Summary; 1.0 PURPOSE; 2.0 DATA">
REVISION SUMMARY

+-----+------------+---------+--------------------------------------------+
| Rev | Date       | Section | Change                                     |
+=====+============+=========+============================================+
| C   | 2023-06-19 | 2.0     | Data table updated after annual load test. |
+-----+------------+---------+--------------------------------------------+

1.0 PURPOSE

Operate the unit safely and keep it available during declared events.

2.0 DATA

+------------------------+--------------------------------+
| Item                   | Value                          |
+========================+================================+
| ATS rating (A)         | 800                            |
| Transfer delay (s)     | 10                             |
| Retransfer delay (min) | 30                             |
| Exercise               | Monthly with load (WDS 03.350) |
+------------------------+--------------------------------+
</passage>
<passage n="02" section="3.0 OPERATION; 4.0 RECORDS">
3.0 OPERATION

3.1 Confirm generator running and ATS on emergency.

3.2 Do not bypass the ATS without the Water Incident Lead's approval.

3.3 On utility return, allow the 30 min retransfer delay; log on F-WDS-207.

CAUTION: Carbon monoxide. Never run a generator inside a building or near an air intake.

4.0 RECORDS

Run hours and fuel on F-WDS-207; defects to the maintenance work queue.
</passage>
</document>
Write one header per passage, in passage order.
